basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Lisbon, Portugal, with a passion for video games and online communities. I love creating intricate designs, both in my professional work and in games like Animal Crossing, where I enjoy building detailed villages. Besides gaming, I'm a foodie who can't resist a good plate of Portuguese pasta and I'm always experimenting with new recipes. In my free time, I indulge in some light anime and manga, with 'TsukiMichi' being a recent favorite. I'm usually online in the evenings, after work, and on weekends. Currently, I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my love for gaming and cooking.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from a Lisbon university and have worked in various design firms for over five years. My gaming knowledge is largely self-taught, gained through years of playing and engaging in online communities. I've also picked up a lot of culinary tips from cooking subreddits and YouTube channels.
